sentences.japanese: 君は二歳の時に十まで数えることができた。
sentences.english: You could count to ten when you were two.
A word is enough to a wise man.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は姉とは一から十まで性格が違う。
sentences.english: She is different from her sister in every way.

sentences.japanese: 彼女に十ドル借りている。
sentences.english: I owe ten dollars to her.

sentences.japanese: 日没までにもう十マイル歩かなければならない。
sentences.english: We have another ten miles to walk before sunset.
